balvikas_classes.current_lesson: Swami's 5 Human Values through Prayers & Stories
balvikas_classes.summary: Learning simple Sai prayers, devotional coloring, and stories illustrating Truth, Right Action, Peace, Love, and Non-Violence.

balvikas_classes.summary: Applying spiritual principles to high school, college prep, career ethics, and youth leadership in the community.

daily_chanting.title: Daily Chanting & Spiritual Sadhana
daily_chanting.tagline: Sanctify every breath with sacred Vedic vibrations and Swami's divine name
daily_chanting.description: Bhagawan Baba emphasizes that regular repetition of the Gayatri Mantra, Sai Gayatri, Veda chanting, and Sri Sathya Sai 108 Ashtothram purifies our thoughts, grants protection, and elevates the spiritual consciousness of the entire family.

items.title: The Universal Gayatri Mantra
items.sanskrit: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
items.transliteration:
Om Bhur Bhuva Suvaha
Tat Savitur Varenyam
Bhargo Devasya Dheemahi
Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayath
items.meaning: We meditate upon the supreme divine brilliance of the Sun of spiritual consciousness, the creator of the physical, subtle, and celestial realms. May that Divine Light illuminate and inspire our intellect.
items.benefits: Swami says chanting the Gayatri Mantra 3 times a day (morning, noon, evening) protects from harm, sharpens the intellect, dispels gloom, and leads to liberation.

items.title: Sri Sathya Sai Gayatri
items.sanskrit: ॐ सायि ईश्वराय विद्महे सत्य देवाय धीमहि । तन्नः सर्वः प्रचोदयात् ॥
items.transliteration:
Om Sayeeshwaraya Vidmahe
Sathya Devaya Dheemahi
Tannah Sarvah Prachodayath
items.meaning: We know the Supreme Lord Sai. We meditate on the Embodiment of Absolute Truth (Sathya Deva). May that Omni-Divine Being enlighten our vision and guide all our actions.
items.benefits: Invokes the direct presence, protection, and grace of Bhagawan Sri Sathya Sai Baba into our home and daily life.

items.title: Sri Sathya Sai Ashtothra Shata Namavali (108 Names)
items.transliteration:
1. Om Sri Sathya Sai Bhagavathe Namah
2. Om Sri Sathya Sai Sathya Swaroopaya Namah
3. Om Sri Sathya Sai Sathya Dharma Parayanaya Namah
4. Om Sri Sathya Sai Varadaya Namah
5. Om Sri Sathya Sai Chithraroopaya Namah
... 108. Om Sri Sathya Sai Sarva Devatha Swaroopaya Namah
items.meaning: The 108 sacred names honoring Bhagawan Sri Sathya Sai Baba, celebrating His divine attributes: Embodiment of Truth, Bestower of boons, Friend of the meek, Supreme Master of the Universe.
items.benefits: Chanted during Thursday and Sunday aarti or morning prayer. Cleanses negative vibrations in the home.

items.title: Sri Rudram - Namakam & Chamakam (Veda Chanting)
items.transliteration:
Om Namo Bhagavate Rudraya
Namaste Rudra Manyava Utota Ishave Namah...
Sham Cha Me Mayash Cha Me Priyam Cha Me Anukāmash Cha Me...
items.meaning: Sacred Vedic hymn from the Krishna Yajur Veda invoking the all-pervading Cosmic Divine in every aspect of nature, asking for inner peace, purity, and universal well-being.
items.benefits: Veda chanting generates profound healing frequencies. Balvikas students and devotees learn to chant with correct swaras (intonation).

items.title: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra (Healing & Protection)
items.sanskrit: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान् मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
items.transliteration:
Om Tryambakam Yajamahe
Sugandhim Pushti-Vardhanam
Urvaarukamiva Bandhanaan
Mrityor Muksheeya Maamritaat
items.meaning: We worship the Three-Eyed Lord Shiva, who is fragrant and nourishes all beings. Just as a ripe melon is effortlessly liberated from its vine, may He free us from the cycle of death and ignorance into the nectar of immortality.
items.benefits: Universal healing mantra chanted for good health, recovery from illness, and emotional fortitude.

items.title: Universal Peace Prayer (Samastha Lokah)
items.sanskrit: समस्ताः लोकाः सुखिनो भवन्तु ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
items.transliteration:
Samastha Lokah Sukhino Bhavantu
Om Shanthi Shanthi Shanthi-hi
items.meaning: May all beings in all the worlds be happy, peaceful, and free from suffering. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.
items.benefits: Swami instructed that this prayer replaces Loka Samastha so that every realm of creation receives divine peace.
items.recommended_count: Chanted at the end of all center meetings & personal prayers (3 times)

all_sevas.description: Andre House serves over 500 hot dinners every single night to homeless and vulnerable neighbors in downtown Phoenix. Center devotees volunteer in dinner preparation, plating, table service, and clothing room hospitality.

all_sevas.title: Bi-Weekly Homeless Hot Breakfast Serving Drive
all_sevas.location: Pioneer Park / Mesa Homeless Shelter Area, Mesa, AZ
all_sevas.description: Preparing and serving hot cooked oatmeal, hard-boiled eggs, fresh bananas, hot coffee, and juice for 80+ homeless brothers and sisters.

all_sevas.title: Back-to-School Backpack & Winter Warmth Drive
all_sevas.location: Mesa Public Schools / Local Family Shelters
all_sevas.description: Collecting new backpacks, notebook supplies, and warm winter jackets and blankets for underprivileged children and families across the East Valley.

seva_fmsc.title: Feed My Starving Children (FMSC) Monthly Packing Seva
seva_fmsc.location: FMSC Tempe Site, 1100 West Grove Parkway, Tempe, AZ 85283

guidelines.title: Closed-Toe Shoes Required
guidelines.desc: Sneakers or work shoes required. No sandals, Crocs with holes, or flip-flops.

guidelines.title: Strictly NO Jewelry
guidelines.desc: FDA cleanroom packaging rule: NO rings, earrings, watches, or bracelets. Plain wedding bands permitted.

guidelines.title: Ages 5+ Welcome
guidelines.desc: Kids 5-9 (1 adult per 3 kids); Ages 10-17 (1 adult per 4 kids).

guidelines.title: Arrive at 2:15 PM
guidelines.desc: Arrive 15 minutes early for check-in, handwashing, and hairnet orientation.

seva_andre_house.title: Andre House of Arizona - Homeless Hospitality & Dinner Service
seva_andre_house.description: Andre House was founded in 1984 to serve the poor and homeless of the Phoenix area, providing food, clothing, showers, and laundry. Devotees assist with chopping vegetables, cooking, setting dining tables, serving 500+ hot plates, and sanitizing the dining hall.
seva_andre_house.age_policy: Minimum age is 14 years old. Volunteers under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or adult guardian.
dress_code: Sturdy closed-toe shoes (non-slip soles recommended, no canvas shoes or sandals).
Short or long sleeve shirts (no sleeveless shirts or tank tops).
Hair tied back neatly; hats or hairnets will be provided in food service areas.

seva_breakfast.title: Bi-Weekly Homeless Hot Breakfast Seva
seva_breakfast.location: Pioneer Park / Mesa Homeless Shelter Area, Mesa, AZ
